release_notes:
1. Storefront DataLayer Push Restoration: Fixed critical issue where saving Back Office settings caused storefront DataLayer pushes to be suppressed due to an obsolete hidden event submission input.
2. Autonomous Self-Healing: Added automatic detection and deletion of corrupted empty canonical events arrays in both Back Office and storefront hooks, ensuring all canonical events default to fully active.
3. Fail-Safe Event Validation: Updated isEventEnabled to guarantee canonical events always evaluate to active even if stored settings decode to empty.
